parts.name: Cabinet Door
parts.Basic_description: This is the cabinet door made of MDF, typically rectangular and attached to the cabinet frame with hinges.
parts.Functional_description: It serves as the access point to the cabinet interior, allowing users to open and close the storage space.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates about its hinges to open or close the cabinet.

parts.name: Cabinet Frame
parts.Basic_description: This is the main structural frame of the cabinet, made of plywood, providing support for the door and shelves.
parts.Functional_description: It holds all other parts together, maintaining the cabinet’s shape and stability.
parts.Movement_description: It is a fixed structure and does not move during normal use.

parts.name: Shelf (Bottom)
parts.Basic_description: This is the bottom shelf of the cabinet, made of particle board, rectangular in shape.
parts.Functional_description: It supports stored items placed at the bottom of the cabinet.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed in place and does not move.

parts.name: Shelf (Middle)
parts.Basic_description: This is the middle shelf of the cabinet, made of particle board, providing mid-level storage.
parts.Functional_description: It divides the cabinet space and supports items placed in the middle section.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed and does not move.

parts.name: Shelf (Top)
parts.Basic_description: This is the top shelf of the cabinet, made of particle board, located near the upper section.
parts.Functional_description: It provides upper-level storage for lighter or less frequently used items.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed and does not move.
